description: Compare estimated search traffic across multiple domains, subdomains, or URLs before spending deeper analysis credits. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

include_featured_snippet.description: Include featured-snippet contributions in the returned estimates when supported. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

include_local_pack.description: Include local-pack contributions in the returned estimates when supported. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

include_paid.description: Include estimates for paid-search traffic when true; this does not buy ads. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

location_code.description: Numeric provider location identifier for the search market; the service validates support alongside the location name. Type: Safe integer. Must be greater than 0. Optional; no client default.

sort_by.description: Metric used to order returned results; choose one of this tool’s accepted enum values. Type: String. Accepted values: "organic_traffic", "total_traffic", "paid_traffic", "opportunity", "target". Default: "organic_traffic".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

targets.description: Domains, subdomains or URLs to compare; provide the target formats supported by this workflow. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 100 items. Required.

items.description: One domain, subdomain or absolute page URL included in the comparison. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_domain_traffic_estimate
title: AgentSEO Domain Traffic Estimate
